description.before: A service lift rises through the bones of the Upper City. A worker network uplink can publish the ledger, while a private dead drop can turn it into a precise weapon against one executive. The lift panel offers a return to Lower City’s Transit Plaza beside a rattling inspection hatch.
description.after: A service lift rises through the bones of the Upper City. A worker network uplink can publish the ledger, while a private dead drop can turn it into a precise weapon against one executive. The lift panel offers a return to Lower City’s Transit Plaza beside a rattling inspection hatch. Beyond the inspection hatch, a separate inspection lift travels down to Archive Vault and returns to this landing. The lift panel still controls the cleared route to Lower City.

before.description: The service lift judders between lockdown floors. The lift panel retains the cleared freight route down to Transit Plaza, and the inspection hatch rattles like the city is trying to shake the crew loose. A worker network uplink and a private dead drop remain accessible beside the panel.

after.description: The service lift judders between lockdown floors. The lift panel still controls the cleared route to Lower City.

description.before: The glasswalk curves along the dome edge with the whole Lower City visible far below. A camera seam runs under the handrail like a vein.
description.after: The glasswalk curves along the dome edge with the whole Lower City visible far below. A camera seam runs under the handrail like a vein. The Archive approach continues east through Donor Gallery, then south down the stairs.

description.before: The Archive Vault rises in indexed crystal stacks over a glass floor two hundred stories high. The lens relic hangs in a containment field that hums toward Nova before she touches it. Command tether-lines vanish into the glass, routing power back toward the Prism Gallery. The catalog wing opens south through Catalog Atrium, with a clear return to the vault.
description.after: The Archive Vault rises in indexed crystal stacks over a glass floor two hundred stories high. The catalog wing opens south through Catalog Atrium, with a clear return to the vault. An inspection lift returns up to Service Lift and can be ridden back down to the vault.

before.description: Crystal stacks strobe red with alarm text. The empty containment field screams around the stolen lens relic. Command tether-lines cross the glass from the Administrator's system; scan tether-lines to follow their deeper geometry. The catalog wing opens south through Catalog Atrium, with a clear return to the vault.

Indexed crystal stacks rise above a glass floor two hundred stories high. The Lens hangs unsupported after the resolved prism route drops containment. The lens relic hangs above the idle containment field, with command tether-lines still running back toward the gallery. The catalog wing opens south through Catalog Atrium, with a clear return to the vault.

description.before: Gravity ends at the hatch. Zero-g cables descend from a superconductor junction through a vertical dark while Hunter-Killer droids scrape along distant walls, too armored to fight head-on. The marked route runs east to Zero-G Junction; the southern tube there leads to the SysAdmin station and Server Farm.
description.after: Gravity ends at the hatch. The marked route runs east to Zero-G Junction; the southern tube there leads to the SysAdmin station and Server Farm. Anchored service cables also offer a direct descent to Server Farm and a climb back to this hatch.

description.before: Mist surrounds a purged backup rack. Recover its routine: erase the guardian ownership flag for independence or use the crew covenant socket for shared protection. A mainframe terminal displays a coolant-pulse map; a dead sysadmin drifts behind a coolant pipe. The SysAdmin Nest west leads back to Zero-G Junction and the upper Ring. Mainframe Nave is north, the backup aisle south, and the Anchor entrance east remains guarded until the Firewall Construct falls.

Anchored service cables climb directly to Service Shaft and provide a return descent. The SysAdmin and Zero-G Junction walking route remains available.
